top_result_summaries.title: Weekly Hospitalization Summary | Department of Health - COVID-19
top_result_summaries.snippet: ## Weekly Hospitalization Summary by Region. # Weekly Hospitalization Summary. * This dashboard will be updated weekly. * New admissions and total hospitalization data come from the Health Electronic Response Data System (HERDS). Hospitals are required to complete this survey each Wednesday for the prior Sunday – Saturday time period. * As of 10/7/25, these data are reported weekly. Prior to this date, COVID-19 hospitalizations were reported on a daily basis. Historical daily data can be accessed via this Open Data COVID-19 hospitalizations file. * As of 10/13/23, HERDS no longer collects information on COVID patients admitted to the ICU while hospitalized. Historical COVID ICU totals are available via this Open Data COVID-19 hospitalizations file. * Population Data: The 2018 US Census Bridged Race Categories file was used for population estimates for 2020-2022. From 2023 on, the US Census Population and Housing Unit Estimates Program will be used for population estimates. Fatalities by region and county. Scroll back to the top of the page.
